sections.name: future_transit_controls
sections.body: VR-101 through VR-103 keep Future Transit as one default-off registry toggle that groups official planned, funded, and under-construction proposal lines with their station markers. The layer still uses the shared Google Maps overlay registry and imported proposal adapter output. Lines render from Polyline objects at proposal zoom ranges; station markers use the existing Marker approach with status color, click metadata, provenance links, and a marker-specific zoom floor to reduce LA-wide clutter.

sections.name: decision
sections.body: Build the first official Future Transit dataset as validated TransitProposal source records that render through the existing import pipeline and Google Maps overlay registry. Use public agency sources for each included project, keep geometry approximation explicit, and keep unofficial or advocacy-only concepts out of the future layer.

sections.name: scope
sections.body: Add a bounded LA-area official future-project batch, source/provenance notes, inclusion and exclusion criteria, validation coverage, and docs for maintainers. Do not add alternate map providers, do not treat Google Maps as the source of future geometry, and do not change route calculation unless a separate Seeds issue requires it.

sections.name: maintenance_followup
sections.body: After VR-105 lands, veloRail-d29c should add the repeatable update workflow: source watch list, freshness metadata or checklist, stale status and opening-year checks, and maintainer instructions for adding, updating, or retiring official future project records.

sections.name: decision:Run the next Seeds pass as a high-priority Overstory batch with separate builders for veloRail-f774, VR-402, VR-503, and VR-303. Keep write scopes isolated: infrastructure harness, freight proposal dataset, GTFS ingestion, and map control UI.

coordination:Use direct builder agents from the coordinator because prior nested lead spawning hit worktree/ref and mail write failures. Each builder must read AGENTS.md, Seeds, Mulch, and its role guidance, then use ov mail list fallback if ov mail check fails.
merge_policy:Merge only after each builder branch is inspected and issue gates pass. Browser-facing UI work must include strict Playwright coverage through npm run issue:gate.

name: remaining-ready-seeds-plan

sections.name: Scope
sections.body: Complete the ten currently ready Seeds issues in four Overstory tracks: VR-404/VR-405/veloRail-967a nationalized rail conversion and toggle, VR-202/VR-203 visionary registry and overlay rendering, VR-104 completed-network comparison mode, and VR-305/VR-306/VR-307/VR-308 UI interaction, responsive, accessibility, and polish pass.

sections.name: Architecture
sections.body: Keep Google Maps as the renderer. Reuse the existing map overlay registry, mapOverlayStore, transit proposal schema/import validation, and design-system components. Add only focused services/data helpers where the current contract lacks a durable model.

sections.name: Verification
sections.body: Each track must add focused unit or browser coverage with issue IDs in test titles so npm run issue:close can find strict browser checks. Full closeout runs npm run quality plus browser gates through npm run issue:close.

description: Implementation plan for remaining currently ready VeloRail Seeds issues

sections.name: Scope
sections.body: Implement the next ready Seeds batch after the remaining-ready batch: visionary provenance/disclaimer UI, initial visionary LA bundle, visionary editorial workflow, freight suitability scoring, initial nationalized passenger scenario, and deterministic candidate route generation from freight corridor topology.

sections.name: Boundaries
sections.body: Keep Google Maps as the renderer only. Do not add alternate map providers. Keep official future records separate from visionary and nationalized planning records. Keep generated passenger routes as review candidates, not approved service.

sections.name: Implementation
sections.body: Extend existing proposal/freight/visionary data contracts where needed. Prefer deterministic data and pure service helpers with focused Node tests, plus browser metadata coverage for user-facing overlay disclaimers and scenario labels.

sections.name: Closeout
sections.body: Run npm run quality, strict issue:close browser gates for all six issues, record Mulch learnings, then sync and push.

sections.name: Scope
sections.body: Complete the final ready Seeds issues: population-density transit scoring and bike-rail multimodal scoring for candidate routes or corridors.

sections.name: Boundaries
sections.body: Use transparent local heuristics and documented source options. Do not claim precise demand, employment, or bike-network accuracy. Do not introduce alternate map providers or disrupt routing.

sections.name: Implementation
sections.body: Add pure scoring helpers that can annotate freight route candidates, document data limitations, test deterministic scoring, and add browser-tag coverage if the close gate requires it.

sections.name: Closeout
sections.body: Run quality, issue gates, Mulch record, close Seeds, sync and push.
